title: Minimax Network Treatment-Effect Estimation with Privatized Outcome Reports under Low-Order Interference
banked_reason: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope. Math and cited-source checks pass; unresolved bank-positioning remains and F never ran.
gap_reasons: The delivered addition combines the inherited bounded raw-response frontier with a binary-report converse and conditional studentization; the published [private-IPW theorem](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/volume26/23-1401/23-1401.pdf) and [general Riesz results](https://arxiv.org/html/2210.08698v3) do not supply this exact composition. The MSE sandwich and both directions of the studentized characterization are proved, and the framing contains no stale claim that an open step is settled. However, the matched MSE frontier takes a supremum over degree-capped graphs, while matching precision for a particular known graph is established only for equal complete blocks. The broader inference characterization encodes worst-table assignment-shift negligibility through exponential coefficient optimization, leaving the efficiently computable moment certificate sufficient rather than necessary. Nominal studentized calibration remains confined to vanishing reporting parameters, and the supplied small exact examples do not establish useful finite-sample calibration at operational graph sizes. These limits make the package a specialized extension rather than a field-level methodological advance and constrain its projected leading-journal score to 5.8. proof_attempt_summary: Three discovery solve rounds developed the saturated original-private-record MSE sandwich and uniform studentization characterization, including a square-root realized-energy bound. The math panel and cited-source checks passed, but the cold novelty referee assessed incremental against field (score ceiling 5.8 versus 7.4), so the operator-directed below-floor stop banked the run as downgraded. The decision-panel bank-positioning finding remains unresolved; F never ran, and future work would require materially re-anchoring the unequal-block fixed-graph frontier rather than retrying this specialization.
tldr: Under an independent fair treatment design and independent binary reporting assignment, the note estimates the finite-population all-treated versus all-control contrast over bounded low-order neighborhood tables. The saturated fixed-channel frontier is \(\rho_n\asymp B^2\min\{1,A_d(d+\lambda^{-2})/n\}\), with universal constants and separate graph-sharing and reporting lower experiments. A public choice between clipped private SNIPE and the zero rule gives the upper bound \(B^2\min\{4,A_d(d+\lambda^{-2}-1)/n\}\). Exact Walsh moments give uniform finite normal error with assignment term \(\sqrt{d\lambda^2}\), and a polynomial-time sufficient certificate for variance consistency and shrinking Wald intervals. Under only \(\lambda_n^2\to0\), an exact finite-optimization criterion characterizes uniform studentized normality; it covers examples with \(d_n\lambda_n^2=1\) and with nonconcentrating score energy. Conditioning before translating gives the realized-energy criterion the sharper finite remainder cost \(\sqrt{\mathfrak r_n}\). The separate inference procedure uses the raw center and the public studentizing scale. Shrinking intervals additionally require \(V_{0,n}\to0\). The bounded mandatory-loop class is a proper subclass of published SNIPE; the raw converse transfers upward by inclusion, while the private binary-channel theorem requires the bounded class. The contribution is a specialist result for this stipulated channel and treatment design.
gap: The low-order SNIPE score and the bounded nonprivate frontier address raw treatment-sharing variation. Iid private-IPW theory addresses population inference. Neither carried result supplies the all-original-report bounded fixed-table converse together with a public uniform network calibration certificate.
fill: The reporting converse is posed against all labeled original-record decision kernels, and the graph-sharing lower experiment survives garbling. A finite Walsh computation certifies reporting-noise dominance, controls low realized energy, and supports a connected raw-center interval. Complete-block and self-only separation fixes the interpretation of the field target. For a prospective feed experiment, fixed cohort and measurement window, public bounded support, and low-order interactions are directly maintained modeling choices; affine centering of a bounded endpoint preserves degree, whereas clipping arbitrary responses requires renewed model justification.
